about: The list the Search box looks through (Settings gear > Search). One line per panel: page, title, desc (one line shown under the title), keywords (extra words people might type, including other names for the same thing), and where to jump to: id (the panel's id on the page) or find (the panel's heading text). Add a line when a panel or page is added. New pages also need an entry in 'pages' below.
